scope: Manual source review of all 36 authored formal question families, their replies and recalls. Mechanical guard is limited to wh-question yes/no mismatches and identified unsupported named/lesson claims; this is not a semantic oracle.

before.q: "Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"

answers.label: "Still figuring everyone out."
answers.react: "Same. But keep your eyes open — some people here are performing, not surviving."

answers.label: (mention someone specific)
answers.react: "Interesting. I'll watch them. Thanks for trusting me with that."

answers.label: "I don't gossip about people."
answers.react: A small smile. "Fair. That's a good policy. Hard to keep, though."

before.follow: "I'll keep my eyes open. Two sets are better than one."
before.deeper: "Watch the quiet ones. Not the loud — the loud tell you everything. The quiet are either thinking or planning, and you can't tell which until it matters."

before.q: "What's the worst thing you've done since the sky changed?"

answers.label: "Yes. I don't want to get into what. But yes."
answers.react: No judgment in their face. "We're all doing math that doesn't add up. You're still here. That counts."

answers.label: "Nothing I'm telling you. Nothing I'm telling anyone."
answers.react: "Okay." They don't push. "When you're ready. If you're ever ready."

answers.label: "Define 'worst.'"
answers.react: "The fact that you have to ask means you're doing better than you think."

before.q: "Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."

answers.label: "Okay — here's one small useful thing I know. Watch."
answers.react: They watch, intent, then try it themselves. "Huh. That actually works." A grin — student and teacher trade places for a minute.

answers.label: "I don't know what I know that you don't. We're all guessing out here."
answers.react: "Then we'll guess together. Two guessers are better than one. That's just math."

answers.label: "I'm not much of a teacher."
answers.react: "Everyone says that. Then they show you something that saves your life. No pressure, though."

before.q: "What day is it? ...Do you still count? I lost track days ago."

answers.label: "I count. Someone has to."
answers.react: "Good. Keep counting. The days need witnesses."

answers.label: "Lost track too. Does it matter?"
answers.react: "Maybe not. But I like that you asked. Means part of you still keeps score."

answers.label: "It's someday. Probably."
answers.react: "Ha. I'll take 'probably.' Close enough for out here."

before.follow: "Days, weeks — we'll make new names for them if we have to."
before.deeper: "I count meals, not days. Three meals since the rain. Two since the alarm. Days are for people with calendars. I have a stomach."

recalls.a_count: "You said you count the days — someone has to. What's the count today? Still keeping it?"
recalls.a_lost: "You'd lost track of the days too. Decided yet whether it matters?"
recalls.a_guess: "You said it's someday, probably. Still someday?"
